722494.Description:
Shift 5 Ink (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Honey Lemon.)
[Synthesize] Whenever this character quests, you may return an item card from your discard to your hand. If you do, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722495.Flavor Text: "The numbers on these ink drops are unreal. I wonder if there's a way to use them to juice up an inkcaster."

722496.Description: [No Hiding] When you play this character, look at chosen opponent's hand.
722496.Flavor Text: “Yoo-hooo! Merlin! What are you playing with? Don’t you know it’s nice to share your toys?”

722497.Description:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
[Civic Duty] 6 Ink — Remove all damage from chosen character or location.

722498.Description:
[Not-So-Secret Crush] This character enters play exerted.
[Filing System] Whenever this character quests, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722499.Description: [Save for the Future] When you play this character, you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
722499.Flavor Text: Life in Hyperia City had never been better.

722500.Description: [Nifty Tech] While you have an item in play, this character gets +1 Lore.
722500.Flavor Text: “What Tadashi did with Baymax is incredible. But my brother never had access to ink drops.”

722501.Description: [Shocking Breakthrough] Whenever this character quests, you pay 1 Ink less for the next item you play this turn.
722501.Flavor Text: "These geodes have really supercharged my research!"

722502.Description: [Lucky Break] Whenever this character quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. Put the card with the highest cost revealed this way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their players' decks.

722503.Description:
[Upper Crust] While you have a character in play with the highest cost, or tied for highest cost, this character gets +1 Lore.
[Proper Etiquette] Whenever this character quests, look at the top card of your deck. Put that card on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

722504.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Lend a Paw] When you play this character, if you played another character this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722505.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[All by Design] At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, you may look at the cards in your inkwell and then you may return one to your hand. If you do either, exert all cards in your inkwell.

722506.Description:
[One of a Kind] Whenever you play an item, if the item you played has a different name than each other item you have in play, draw a card.
[Personal Collection] For each item with a different name you have in play, this character gets +1 Lore.

722507.Description:
Shift 5 Ink (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Cinderella.)
[Bespoke Design] At the end of your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on either the top or the bottom of your deck and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722508.Description:
Shift Remove 2 ink drops (You may remove 2 ink drops to play this on top of one of your characters named Baymax.)
[Supercharge] If you would get an ink drop, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.

722509.Description: [Clever Plan] When you play this character, you may put chosen opposing character with cost 2 or less into their player's inkwell facedown and exerted.

722510.Description: [Improve the View] When you play this character, you may banish chosen item. If you do, its player puts the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.

722511.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
722511.Flavor Text:
“Just watch it. Doug is the opposite of friendly. He’s unfriendly.”
—Duke Weaselton

722512.Description: Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted. Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722512.Flavor Text: "What strange rocks! I'd better take one to Merlin."

722513.Description:
(A character with cost 3 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put one into your inkwell facedown and exerted, one on the top of your deck, and one on the bottom of your deck.

722514.Description: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put one into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you removed an ink drop to play this action, look at the top 5 cards of your deck instead.

722515.Description: Put chosen opposing character with cost 2 or less into their player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
722515.Flavor Text: “For the last time, I don’t take on apprentices!”

722516.Description:
[Destabilize] [Exert], 2 Ink — Banish this item.
[Brilliant Burst] During your turn, when this item is banished, you may get 1 ink drop. If you do, chosen character gets -2 Strength this turn. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722517.Description:
[Destabilize] [Exert], 2 Ink — Banish this item.
[Enigma Burst] During your turn, when this item is banished, you may get 1 ink drop. If you do, chosen character of yours gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722518.Description: [Hat Couture] Whenever you play this or another item, if the item you played has a different name than each other item you have in play, you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722519.Description: [It's Got Pockets!] [Exert], 1 Ink, Banish one of your other items — Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

722520.Description: [Break Time] Once during your turn, whenever a Super character quests while here, return an item card from your discard to your hand.

722521.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Take . . . Your . . . Time] All characters lose Rush and can't gain Rush.

722522.Description:
[Magical Travel] When you play this character, you may move him to a location for free.
[Arcane Deliveries] Once during your turn, whenever this character moves to a location, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722523.Description: [Trusty Umbrella] While this character has no damage, he gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
722523.Flavor Text: “I don’t mind a spot of villainy, but there’s no excuse for rudeness!”

722524.Flavor Text: "Sorry! I've got a delivery on the other side of the city and it can't wait!"

722525.Flavor Text: There are no alligators in the canals of Hyperia City. There is, however, a crocodile.

722526.Description: [Handpicked] When you play this character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
722526.Flavor Text: "There's a little something for everyone here."

722527.Description: [To the Ends of the Realm] This character gets +1 Lore for each location you have in play.
722527.Flavor Text: "There's still so much of Lorcana to explore."

722528.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)

722529.Description: Alert (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
722529.Flavor Text: "Sonny, I was asked to guard this door by my Illumineer, and that's just what I'm gonna do."

722530.Description: [Well, That's Broken] When you play this character, you may banish chosen item.
722530.Flavor Text: “Hoooo boy, I’m gonna need a spool of wire, a spatula, and at least seven ice cubes to get this running again.”

722531.Description: [Competitive Edge] While you have an ink drop, this character gains Challenger +3. (They get +3 Strength while challenging.)
722531.Flavor Text: ”Pffft. Not like I need an ink drop to win. But I won’t say no.”

722532.Description: [Unbecoming Behavior] When you play this character, opponents can't play actions until the start of your next turn.
722532.Flavor Text: The size of a house slipper with the heart of a tiger.

722533.Description:
[I Know These Streets] Whenever this character quests, you may move him to a Hyperia City location for free.
[Stop Right There] 6 Ink — Chosen opposing character can't challenge until the start of your next turn.

722534.Description:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)
[Spoils of Victory] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722535.Description: [Careful Crafting] When you play this character, you may pay 1 Ink to get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722535.Flavor Text:
"You need a strong arm and a strong mind to craft these ink drops."
—Merlin

722536.Description: [Sharp Little Claws] When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

722537.Description: [A Little Treat] Whenever this character quests, if an opposing character took damage this turn, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722537.Flavor Text: “Danger is no excuse to forget one’s manners.”

722538.Description: [Payment Up Front] This character can't quest or challenge unless you got an ink drop this turn.
722538.Flavor Text: "I guess now’s the best time to mention that the tip isn’t included with the shippin’ fee . . .”

722539.Flavor Text:
“Times were tough back then. Koslov and me, we were just two young mammals trying to make our way in the world. I helped him out, he helped me out.”
—Mr. Big

722540.Description: [Well Deserved] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, draw a card.
722540.Flavor Text: “I tell you, I won't have any of Marvin's ink drop nonsense, and that's final!"

722541.Description: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
722541.Flavor Text: “Hey, no fair! You’re air pirates—you’re not supposed to attack me on the ground!”

722542.Description:
Shift 3 Ink (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Kit Cloudkicker.)
[Aerial Acrobatics] Whenever this character quests, choose one:
• Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
• Deal 1 damage to chosen character.

722543.Description:
Shift 4 Ink (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Arthur.)
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)
[Victory Purse] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, draw a card and get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722544.Description: [Ice Out] At the end of your turn, if all cards in your inkwell are exerted, chosen opposing character can't challenge until the start of your next turn.

722545.Description:
[New Incentive] When you play this character, chosen character can challenge ready characters this turn.
[Corner the Market] Once during your turn, whenever one of your other characters banishes another character in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722546.Description:
Shift 5 Ink (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Tiana.)
[Ideal Venue] When you play this character, you may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card. If you discarded a location card this way, you may play it from your discard for free.

722547.Description: Deal 2 damage to chosen character. If you removed an ink drop to play this action, deal 5 damage instead.
722547.Flavor Text:
“Jousting is a fine skill. It’s . . . it’s a highly developed science.”
—Sir Pellinore

722548.Description: Deal 4 damage to chosen character. Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722548.Flavor Text:
“I prefer the term ‘unanticipated rapid deconstruction.’”
—Honey Lemon

722549.Description: Draw a card. Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722549.Flavor Text:
“What we sell is power. The power of convenience.”
—Shere Khan

722550.Description:
(A character with cost 7 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Play a location from your hand or discard for free. If a character sang this song, you may move them to that location for free.

722551.Description:
[Easy Commute] [Exert] — Move a character of yours to a location for free.
[Stylish Convenience] Your Hyperia City locations get +2 Willpower.

722552.Description:
[Dodge This!] When you play this item, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
[Barrel Roll] [Exert], 1 Ink — Chosen character gains Alert this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)

722553.Description: [Free Souvenir] Once during your turn, whenever a character moves here, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722554.Description: [High Security] Characters can't be challenged while here.
722554.Flavor Text: Shere Khan's business headquarters, home to an ink drop empire.

722555.Description: [I've Got This] While you have another Detective character in play, this character gains Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

722556.Description:
Shift 2 Ink (You may pay 2 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Judy Hopps.)
[Got You Now] When you play this character, if you played another character this turn, you may banish chosen character with 5 Strength or more.

722557.Description:
[Musical Legacy] When you play this item, draw a card.
[From the Heart] [Exert], 1 Ink — Chosen character gains Singer and counts as having +2 cost to sing songs this turn.

722558.Description: [Anything for You] When you play this character, chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging.)

722559.Flavor Text:
"Tink finds the most unusual things. It makes traveling together an adventure!"
—Cordelia, an Illumineer

722560.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
[The Indignity!] When this character is banished in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722561.Description: [Gathering Data] Whenever this character is challenged, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)
722561.Flavor Text: "If I go 6% faster with one ink drop, what happens when I have two?"

722562.Description: [City Adventures] When you play this character, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an item card named Belle's City Guide or an action card, you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

722563.Description: [Resupply] When you play this character, if you have 2 or more items in play, get 2 ink drops. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 Ink.)
722563.Flavor Text: "My analysis concludes that ink drops can improve operational outcomes by 80%."

722564.Description:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
[Super Stoked] Once during your turn, whenever you play a song, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 Ink.)

722565.Description:
Singer 2 (This character counts as cost 2 to sing songs.)
[Strike a Chord] When you play this character, you may put the top card of your deck into your discard.

722566.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Put the top 3 cards of your deck into your discard. Chosen character gets +1 Strength this turn for each song card in your discard.

722567.Description: [Save for the Future] When you play this character, you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
722567.Flavor Text: Life in Hyperia City had never been better.

722568.Description: [Safety First] When you play this character, if you removed an ink drop to play him, your other characters gain Resist +1 and Ward until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

722569.Description:
[Not-So-Secret Crush] This character enters play exerted.
[Filing System] Whenever this character quests, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722570.Description: [Handpicked] When you play this character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
722570.Flavor Text: "There's a little something for everyone here."

722571.Description: [Unbecoming Behavior] When you play this character, opponents can't play actions until the start of your next turn.
722571.Flavor Text: The size of a house slipper with the heart of a tiger.

722572.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Take . . . Your . . . Time] All characters lose Rush and can't gain Rush.

722573.Description:
[Melodic Refrain] When you play this character, return a song card you played this turn with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.
[Joyous Reception] At the end of your turn, if you played a song this turn, gain 1 lore.

722574.Description: [Share the Music] While you have a song card in your discard, this character gets +1 Lore and gains Singer 3.

722575.Description:
Sing Together 6
For the rest of this turn, you may play characters from your discard. If you do, they enter play exerted and you can't play characters with the same name as characters you played this way this turn.

722576.Description: [Picture Perfect] Whenever this character quests, you may choose another character and reveal a character card in your hand. If they have the same name, draw a card.

722577.Description:
[Untapped Potential] When you play this character, get 1 ink drop.
[Thrilling Discovery] Whenever this character quests, draw a card.

722578.Description:
Sing Together 3
Choose 2 characters of yours. If one of them is cost 3 or less, return both to your hand.

722579.Description:
[Sweet Remix] When you play this character, you may choose and discard a song card. If you do, draw 2 cards.
[Brand-New Playlist] While you have 5 or more song cards in your discard, this character gets +3 Lore.

722580.Description:
Shift 3 Ink
[Hyperia City Tips] During your turn, whenever this character exerts, you pay 2 Ink less for the next action you play this turn.
[Hyperia City Secrets] During your turn, whenever you play a third action, gain 3 lore.

722581.Description: [Quietly Released] When you play this character, put chosen opposing character with 3 Strength or less on the bottom of their player's deck.

722582.Description:
Shift 4 Ink
[Big Hit] Whenever this character quests and whenever he sings a song for the first time each turn, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a song card and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your discard.

722583.Description:
Shift 3 Ink
[Ancestral Wisdom] While you have 10 or more cards in your discard, this character gets +2 Strength and +2 Lore.

722584.Description:
[Way of the Hero] When you play this character, chosen character gets +2 Strength and gains "Whenever this character challenges another character, draw a card" this turn.
[Warrior Spirit] Whenever this character quests, chosen character gains Rush this turn.

722585.Description: [Lucky Break] Whenever this character quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. Put the card with the highest cost revealed this way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their players' decks.

722586.Description:
[One of a Kind] Whenever you play an item, if the item you played has a different name than each other item you have in play, draw a card.
[Personal Collection] For each item with a different name you have in play, this character gets +1 Lore.

722587.Description:
Shift Remove 2 ink drops
[Supercharge] If you would get an ink drop, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.

722588.Description: [A Little Treat] Whenever this character quests, if an opposing character took damage this turn, get 1 ink drop.

722589.Description:
Shift 5 Ink
[Ideal Venue] When you play this character, you may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card. If you discarded a location card this way, you may play it from your discard for free.

722590.Description: [To the Ends of the Realm] This character gets +1 Lore for each location you have in play.

722591.Description:
Adventurous
[Hot Dog!] At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, each player gets 1 ink drop.

722592.Description:
Shift 5 Ink
[Bespoke Design] At the end of your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on either the top or the bottom of your deck and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

722932.Description:
(This counter doesn't count as a card.)
You may remove this counter to pay 1 Ink.

(This counter doesn't count as a card.)
You may remove this counter to pay 1 Ink.
